info.description:
Obtained from Lead Test Engineer (Team Thundercats).

## Authorization
Auth for the document API is the same API key as `api_key_value` but base64 encoded in the format: `"Basic " + base64(key)`.

request.description:
# Create document
This endpoint requires a JSON body consisting of at least a category, company number, and transaction ID. It returns a document ID as its response. The transaction ID used in the request is generated in the pre-request script. The post-request script stores the generated document ID in the environment for the subsequent endpoints.

header.description: Prevents deletion of the source image

request.description:
# Create document with TIFF
This does the same as the `POST document` above, but adds an additional field to the request body `stored_image_url` which points to a TIFF in the `document-api-images-cidev` S3 bucket. When you send the request, the TIFF will be downloaded and converted to a PDF for storage. When you perform a `GET document content by id` you will see the converted PDF.

TIFF is the only Content-Type that gets converted to PDF. XHTML for example is stored and retrieved as-is.

The `No-Deletion` header has been set on this request. Without this the source image (TIFF) will be deleted after being processed. `No-Deletion` having any value at all will prevent this.

request.description:
# Create document with TIFF
This does the same as the `POST document` above, but adds an additional field to the request body `stored_image_url` which points to an XHTML file in the `document-api-images-cidev` S3 bucket. When you later perform a `GET document content by id` you will see the submitted XTHML file.

The `No-Deletion` header has been set on this request. Without this the source image (TIFF) will be deleted after being processed. `No-Deletion` having any value at all will prevent this.

# Search document(s)
This endpoint searches for a document given a transaction ID. It may return multiple documents if there are more than one against the transaction.

# Get document metadata
This endpoint returns all metadata associated with a document.

# Upload document content

This endpoint is used to upload content to an existing document, the possible content types are as follows:

| **Content-Type** | **Extension** |
| --- | --- |
| application/pdf | pdf |
| application/xml | xml |
| application/ixbrl | xhtml |
| application/xhtml+xml | xhtml |
| application/json | json |
| application/zip | zip |
| text/csv | csv |

This request uploads a PSC01 PDF.

# Upload document content

This endpoint is used to upload content to an existing document, the possible content types are as follows:

| **Content-Type** | **Extension** |
| --- | --- |
| application/pdf | pdf |
| application/xml | xml |
| application/ixbrl | xhtml |
| application/xhtml+xml | xhtml |
| application/json | json |
| application/zip | zip |
| text/csv | csv |

This request uploads a ZIP file that contains a PSC01 PDF.

# Get document content
This endpoint gets the content (see POST endpoint for possible content types) associated with a document.
